headline: AutoGPT’s filesystem and shell access create moderate pairwise injection, leakage, and workflow-conflict risk with nuwa-skill’s undocumented integration surface.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: AutoGPT can read and act on filesystem content and execute shell/subprocesses, so if nuwa-skill outputs are bridged into its workspace, prompt-like content could be treated as instructions. nuwa-skill exposes no IO surfaces, so the interaction is inferred rather than documented; uncertainty pushes this above low.
conditions: IF nuwa-skill outputs are copied into AutoGPT’s filesystem workspace
IF AutoGPT parses file contents as task instructions without provenance checks
mitigations: Separate the agents into different directories
Disable automatic ingestion of newly written files
Require a human review step before AutoGPT reads nuwa-skill outputs
Add provenance tags to shared artifacts

B_data_leakage.rationale: AutoGPT has filesystem access and allowlisted egress, but neither profile shows sensitive data classes or shared credentials. nuwa-skill has no documented workspace or secrets handling, so leakage is possible only through an unusual shared-file setup and the blast radius appears small from the available profiles.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same workspace directory
IF sensitive files are placed in that shared directory
mitigations: Keep secrets out of shared folders
Rotate any credentials stored near the workspace

C_capability_conflict.rationale: AutoGPT can write via filesystem and spawn subprocesses, while nuwa-skill’s writable surfaces are undocumented. Because AutoGPT does not support multiple instances and no locking is shown, concurrent modification conflicts are plausible if both touch the same files or artifacts; uncertainty warrants medium rather than low.
conditions: IF both agents write to the same directory or artifact set
IF no external lock or queue serializes their writes
mitigations: Use file locks for shared artifacts

D_cascading_error.rationale: AutoGPT can generate outputs from files and shell actions, and nuwa-skill is a runnable consumer of docs-only evidence with no documented verification step. If nuwa-skill treats AutoGPT output as authoritative, errors can cascade into downstream research artifacts; the pathway is inferred, not directly evidenced, so medium fits.
conditions: IF nuwa-skill consumes AutoGPT-produced text without independent verification
IF AutoGPT output is used as source material for reports or actions
mitigations: Mark AutoGPT outputs as untrusted drafts

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance-sensitive data classes, residency constraints, or certification mismatches are documented for either agent. AutoGPT and nuwa-skill are both open-source with empty data-class fields, so no plausible compliance breach pathway is supported by the profiles.
conditions: IF either agent is later configured to process regulated data classes
IF a deployment adds residency or retention requirements not shown in the profiles
mitigations: Avoid regulated data in this pair
